component.name: Kinema
component.summary: Browse movies and TV series with a native desktop interface

description.p: Kinema is a pre-release Rust desktop application using GPUI. Browse movie and series metadata, inspect available streams, and prepare authorized media for playback in a separately installed external player.

The application includes metadata provider settings, optional debrid integration, managed media storage, and operating-system secure credential storage. Provider accounts and an external player may be required. This scaffold is under development; complete workflows and platform support have not yet been accepted.
